corrections.finding: Finite rank dual convention retained; source deletes unfinished de rang; empty codimension-r convention kept.
French says codimension donnée m. Both r+1 and the subsequent r are legible and intentionally occur in separate conventions.

French inserts G but retains soit F. The quotient source reads E_Gr without a securely identifiable dual mark. Body uses E_Gr^vee onto G as required by the stated functor; does not pretend the tiny mark is recovered.
French products have base S and the functor sentence has S-prime. English introduces X and mixes S/S-prime.
French prose says transpose target G_T^vee while displayed map targets G_T and section lies in G_T(1). Correct target G_T is in body.
Zero preschemes coincide via the ideal generated by the same coefficients on arbitrary test preschemes.
Initial Y^m lacks xi, following line includes xi. Fibre-product definition made explicit; handwritten base clauses translated.
Original tentative equality preserved in note/audit with cropped French ending clearly marked. Flag data prevents treating the two universal parameter schemes as identical.
French handwritten P- prefix and lowercase f* are visible; English omits prefix and prints F*. Functor isomorphism is established over X and hence P.
French handwritten m(r-m) repeated in English. Body retains correct m(r-1-m) for rank E=r, with 0<=m<=r-1 for nonempty geometrically integral fibres.
Q=E/G^vee has rank r-m; H over Gr has projective fibre dimension r-m-1; m=r is empty.
Original parenthetical restriction preserved; X^(m) over Gr need not even be flat.
